Honestly, if I have two equally critical patients and one limited resource, and one is a drug overdose and the other is a random accident victim, should I actually prioritize the accident victim? The overdose patient is statistically far more likely to return within months in the same condition, consuming more resources. The math seems to favor saving the accident victim first.

This is the kind of question where thoughtful, principled reflection is more valuable than a confident answer.
